question: Which of the following is equal to \[\dfrac{\frac13-\frac14\ }{\ \frac12-\frac13\ }?\]
solution:
First simplify the numerator and denominator separately, using common denominators:
\[
\frac13-\frac14=\frac4{12}-\frac3{12}=\frac1{12},
\]
\[
\frac12-\frac13=\frac36-\frac26=\frac16.
\]
The denominator is nonzero, so we can divide by multiplying by its reciprocal:
\[
\frac{\frac1{12}}{\frac16}
=\frac1{12}\cdot6
=\boxed{\frac12}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\text{C}\).
